moa.t: Reduces splanchnic blood flow and portal pressure, inhibits GI hormone and insulin secretion

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Octreotide, IV, bolus, 1–2 mcg/kg immediately, then 1–5 mcg/kg/hour by infusion. Specialist initiated.

cautions.t: Used for variceal bleeding and sulfonylurea-induced hypoglycaemia

adverse_effects.t: Nausea, abdominal cramps, hyper- or hypoglycaemia, bradycardia, gallstones with long use
